# EgressAPIKEY

> Multi-port socks5/http forwarder between AI gateways and upstream providers — sticky exit-IP routing for AI API keys, with a topology canvas. Desktop shell (Tauri 2 + React 19) over a Resin Go sidecar reachable only through a loopback REST seam. License: GPL-3.0-or-later.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): project overview, download, features, quick start (English)

- [docs index](docs/README.md): map of the documentation tree (architecture, ADRs, how-to, reference)
- [Capability matrix](docs/reference/CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md): current verified surface — every claim anchored to CI evidence, unverified claims listed explicitly

## Key ADRs

- [ADR-0067 — License layering & provenance](docs/adr/0067-license-layering-provenance.md): GPL-3.0-or-later shell; Resin sidecar declared MIT with a GPL-3.0-or-later dependency tree (sing-box); mere-aggregation invariant
- [ADRs](docs/adr/): full index of architecture decision records (MADR format)
